name: Forced displacement
summary: UN says Yemen fighting has displaced 364,000 since August; no event displacing over 500,000 in a month found
state: UN humanitarian chief Tom Fletcher said on 25 Nov that renewed fighting in Yemen has displaced more than 364,000 people since August (ABC News). UNHCR said on 10 Nov that about 64,000 people have fled northern Nigeria to Niger this year (DevelopmentAid), and IOM reported more than 5,000 people fleeing North Darfur villages on 10–11 Nov (A News). None amounts to a new event displacing 500,000 people in a month, so the signal stays Normal.
for_you: UNHCR, IOM and WFP appeals set out the needs of displaced people in Yemen, Sudan and the Sahel.
rubric_hit: No new event displacing > 500,000 in a month = Normal
